Your Research. Your Momentum. 
 
•The Momentum MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme is a 5-year initiative aimed at attracting and nurturing up to 35 exceptional postdoctoral researchers from around the globe, enabling them to collaborate with "Lendület" Momentum research groups in Hungary. 
•Successful candidates will benefit from a competitive salary, allowances, top-tier research opportunities, and extensive training and development support. The postdoctoral research period ranges from a minimum of 1 year to a maximum of 3 years, including a mandatory secondment period of 1 to 3 months. The full 3-year duration is encouraged to maximize the programme’s benefits and research impact.
•The first call for applications opens on April 2nd, 2025, seeking 15 postdoctoral fellows.  
 
About “Lendület” Momentum Programme
 
•Launched in 2009, "Lendület," Momentum, is the flagship research programme of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences (MTA). To date, it has supported over 220 independent research groups across diverse fields, empowering top scientists to innovate with full autonomy.
•Co-Funding Excellence: Momentum MSCA Premium Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme is co-funded by the European Union and the Secretariat of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences under the prestigious Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions grant. 
•Details about the Programme are available in the attached brochure and on the Programme website:  Momentum MSCA Postdoctoral Programme │MSCA Fellowship │ Hungary.
•For the latest news and insights, follow the Programme on LinkedIn, Facebook, and X (Twitter).
•Inquiries regarding the Programme may be directed to momentum.msca@office.mta.hu .
